# GdayMeetings 0.3.0

GdayMeetings now owns shared user login through a pluggable OAuth/OIDC layer backed by canonical Payload accounts, following the ase-user-study login model. The Rust app can sign in, upload recordings, and let Gday execute transcription. Includes OAuth discovery, public client registration, S256 PKCE, five-minute access tokens, rotating/revocable refresh tokens, and SQLite/Postgres migrations. Meeting search runs under the authorizing user's collection permissions.

**Upgrade:** back up database/audio first; migrations run on production startup. Set SERVER_URL to the public HTTPS origin. Reconnect MCP clients through browser login: GDAY_MCP_TOKEN and GDAY_API_TOKEN no longer authorize /mcp. Existing worker service authentication is unchanged.

Configure RUNPOD_ENDPOINT_URL and RUNPOD_API_KEY together on the Gday server to enable transcription. These remain server-only.

Container: ghcr.io/rankun203/gday-meetings:0.3.0 (Linux AMD64 and ARM64).
